chapter: Building the band, Ivie Anderson and touring
title: Ivie Anderson as person and the open mic at the Regal
summary: Greer describes her personality and a morning mic gaffe.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: What kind of person did Ivie Anderson strike you as?

Her personality. Doll! she was a doll. She was doll from A to Z. We used to chatter and play cards. She was right in the middle of it. And lucky, oh my God. We buy a new car every year, she used to just wash us away. Expert gambler. That's right. And a doll. We want to go out cabareting, she said I'm going too, said all right, no matter, she'd come and go. Said I want to go too, and she was the only girl and we had the guys like her brother and she went everywhere with us.

And partner, Ivie Anderson, I tell you, I can recall it like it was yesterday, Ivie Anderson, when she walked up on the stage, the way she -- when she come on the stage from the side, and walking straight, before she said a word, she got the people in the palm of her hand. I tell you, Loretta Young, you ever seen her?
How she used to come through the door and switch, she stole that off Ivie. That's how Ivie -- Ivie

come through there, look like a million dollars and switching, then she had everybody in the palm of her hand. She looked like a little doll, she didn't care about nobody. She knew -- she had been a professional a long time, you know, from then on -- from that first time she -- when she switched out in the middle of the stage, hell, looked like a natural doll. And I know a lot of times, she would sing, she would start her song, she never knew what I was going to say and we were in Chicago, in the Regal Theatre, colored theatre, so I had a mike up by them drums, you know, and I didn't know it was on, so the first show in the morning. I had been out cabaretting and now, I'm half woozy, so she goes into her song. I don't know the damn mike is on.
I say, 'Baby, they got it, god damn it, they got me this morning' and the house fell in. The man said keep that in. This is the first show. I was so embarrassed.

She turned around and looked at me. Well, she picked up fast, said 'I told you don't stay out there cabaretting all night long.' Everybody thought it was our act. That's right. I didn't know the mike was on.
